title: Lior and the Horizon
author: Paloma Amberdale
blurb: Gideon Reyes, an archaeologist's estranged child and better digger, keeps moving because stopping costs more. Then an expedition upriver stops answering the radio — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must cross the range ahead of the snows before the dry season ends.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
